about: Modwerk source-only control-in-actions package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/control-in-actions.

mods.title: Control In Actions
mods.summary: A footswitch or gate on EXP/CV IN 1 or 2 holds or toggles MUTE or live recording, or holds or latches FILL.
mods.description: Stock's CONTROL INPUT menus get an ACTION mode: a footswitch or a 0 to 5 V gate on EXP/CV IN 1 or 2 holds or toggles the MUTE screen or live recording, or holds or latches FILL. The input is read in the audio interrupt, so an action plays as soon as a panel key would. Bars beside the menu show the input and when it counts as pressed, ACTION LEARN reads a footswitch's levels, and NO in either learn keeps the saved levels.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: This source ran on the author's Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 in a 16-module combined image (LP01, as reported): the footswitch action plays, and with ACTION OFF nothing plays; this package has not run alone on a unit.
